items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: That was Doc Cheatham and Mario and the saxophone was Johnny Nieto, Freddy Skerrittand Pin Madera.

ctx.x: That nobody would pull a trick like that.
Absolutely. So we went out and I say okay, so Mario ahh - Doc Cheatham got sick and Mario, Calloway was looking for Mario and Mario got Doc Cheatham's place.
Yeah, but the band leader got the job, right? Your group didn't get it.
